text:
taylor: merged cust-quartz/lora into staging — used q4_0 for most tensors, left lm_head fp16. kicking off quartz-quickpack.
vikram: nice. did the finetune add any special tokens or soft prompts?
chen: LoRA prep added an <AMOUNT> placeholder via added_tokens during training but we didn't commit a tokenizer change to prod. training eval looked fine though.
taylor: starting eval on ded-proxy pool. will post summary when complete.
eval-bot: QuickEval: quartz-quickpack finished on staging@quartz-lora
  summary: 77/88 checks passed, 11 flagged, 0 crashes
  regressions: invoice-amount extraction F1 -2.4% (baseline 91.5 -> 89.1)
  hotspots: token-splitting around <AMOUNT>, negative amounts, thousands separators
  artifacts: s3://redwood/artifacts/quartz/5923456789/quickpack-report.html
vikram: can you paste a repro example?
taylor: repro (sanitized):
```
OCR: "Total Due: <AMOUNT>-$2,345.67\nInvoice: 99001"
Expected: {"amount":"2345.67","currency":"USD","invoice_id":"99001"}
Model: "amount":"2 345 . 67 ", currency:"USD", note:"token: < AMOUNT >"
```
chen: token-split is causing spaces and the downstream parser expects canonical numeric tokens. combined with quant noise the LM emits extra spaces.
vikram: options:
  1) quick runtime postproc: collapse token sequences ["<","AMOUNT",">"] -> "<AMOUNT>" and normalize numeric whitespace before parsing (fast)
  2) re-export with lm_head fp16 (already done) + try keeping output projection fp16 if we see more drift
  3) retokenize (add_special_tokens) + light fusion if runtime remap insufficient
  4) small canary with 2% traffic and Console monitors
taylor: I'll implement (1) now and re-run quickpack. also schedule a perf run to confirm latency impact.
eval-bot: note: customer quartz rollback threshold = 3.0% F1 drop for invoice pipeline
ops-bot: created ticket ML-4810: "quartz LoRA token-split regression" assigned to taylor. https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/ML-4810
deploy-bot: scheduled re-run quartz-quickpack (run_id=run-5923456789-2) on ded-proxy-3, ETA ~12m
chen: adding an exact-match numeric canonicalization test to the quickpack so future runs gate faster.
taylor: rerun done — mixed mitigation reduced parse failures, new quickpack summary on artifacts. will attach link in ticket. :thumbsup:
